name: zc_fire_material_probe

tests.name: M_WL_Fire loads and declares a Color parameter
a plain slab wearing M_WL_Fire actually draws

detail.note: the engine cube brings its own UVs. If this draws and the mascot does not, the material is sound and the fault is in the ribbons -- their UVs, or the material assigned to the section.

tests.name: the mascot's flames survive being moved onto M_WL_Fire

detail.note: the founder's regression, stated as a measurement. A large drop means the ribbons go dark on the material even when a slab wearing it does not.
